matching-decompilation.label: Matching decompilation
matching-decompilation.description: Upstream describes source reconstruction targeting the original compiled binary. This is a method or goal, not a claim of 100% completion or a build verified by this library.

nonmatching-decompilation.label: Non-matching decompilation
nonmatching-decompilation.description: Upstream explicitly describes reconstruction that does not target an identical original binary.

rewrite.label: Rewrite / reimplementation
rewrite.description: An implementation intended to reproduce game behavior, rather than establish an identical original binary.

ghidra-pseudocode.label: Ghidra pseudocode
ghidra-pseudocode.description: The project includes or reports Ghidra-generated pseudocode exports. This alone establishes neither compilable reconstruction nor matching code nor a playable port.

disassembly.label: Disassembly
disassembly.description: Reconstructed assembly source for an original executable or ROM.

static-recompilation.label: Static recompilation
static-recompilation.description: Translation of original machine code for another host or runtime, rather than a matching source decompilation.

official-source-release.label: Official source release
official-source-release.description: Source published by the original game's developer.

source-port.label: Source port
source-port.description: A source-based adaptation for other platforms; this tag does not certify completeness or playability.

experimental-port.label: Experimental port scaffold
experimental-port.description: An early port workspace or scaffold, without a verified completed playable port.

generated-code.label: Mechanically generated code
generated-code.description: Parts of the source are emitted by tools from instruction patterns or blocks. This can overlap with matching reconstruction; the evidence note distinguishes generated expressions from instruction wrappers.

tooling.label: Tool / library
tooling.description: Supporting tooling, bindings or libraries; game-completion percentages do not apply.
